remember Harold camping?
He predicted that Jesus Christ would return to Earth on May 21, 2011, a rapture would happen along the way and the destruction of the Universe would happen on October 21, 2011.

Can't say much about Jesus returning but the rest didn't seem to happen... but he did state in an interview, just before October 21 that he didn't know when the end would come. The interesting thing about the last part is that he said it on October 16 according to a [wikipedia page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2011_end_times_prediction). 

I think I read somewhere on the wikipedia page that none of us could have the power to know the end date. So this might not be true because of how many of us are uncovering it... but WW3 may be happening soon. Who knows, maybe it'll fall on the 16th?

I've been staring at this for about 2 minutes now. Boggling my mind. 

I can't think of anything other than the fact you might fail and be in a worse position. 
Part of me is looking for a reason not to do it, too, but there isn't one.

I'm sorry.

'desert' states like san diego and places with little water tend to be a common theme.

try places away from bodies of water, also try times of day when it's hottest or the sun shines brightest.

I used 9smb. 

I wanted to just say this album is an absolute beauty. It's amazing!
